description: Fetches a public web page, following up to 5 redirects, and reports its HTTPS redirect chain, security response headers and cookie flags, with a fix for each problem. Faster than audit_website_security and gives no grade: it does not check TLS, the certificate, DNS, email records or page content. Refuses IP addresses, ports other than 80 and 443, and any host that resolves to a private, loopback, link-local, carrier-grade NAT or cloud metadata address.

url.description: Website address to check, such as example.com or https://example.com/. Only http and https on ports 80 and 443. Any query string is removed before the request.

name: check_security_headers

cookieCount.description: Number of Set-Cookie headers on the final response

effort.description: How much work the fix is

severity.description: critical, high, medium and low lower the score. harden is optional hardening and never counts. pass is a check that passed.

headers.description: Values from the final response, cleaned and shortened. A header that is not set is left out.

notes.description: Checks that did not finish, were skipped or saw partial data

url.description: Address requested at this hop, without query string

target.description: Final address after redirects, without query string

title: Check security headers
